title: Descriptive Writing
author: 640f03e224719250f8fb7751
chapter_outcomes: Articulate experience and express what is thought, felt and imagined (W1)
Organise and structure ideas and opinions for deliberate effect (W2)

Write about 350–450 words in response to one of four titles: two descriptive and two narrative
